newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Turkmen ask Mobil, Monument to fix fields -agency.
newsitem.headline: Turkmen ask Mobil, Monument to fix fields -agency.

text.p: Turkmenistan has asked Mobil Corp and Britain's Monument Oil & Gas Plc to rehabilitate over 2,000 oil wells in Balkan region in the west of the country, Interfax news agency said on Thursday.
It did not give a source for the information but said that Turkmen President Saparmurat Niyazov had met oil executives and named the firms "strategic partners" recently.
Interfax quoted Turkmen figures as saying the Balkan region fields had confirmed reserves of over two million tonnes of crude.
Monument in August signed a 25-year exploration and production-sharing agreement with Turkmenistan covering 2,500 square km, also in the west of the Central Asian state.
